name: Patagonykus
sum: Large alvarezsaurid from the Turonian–Coniacian Portezuelo Formation of Neuquén, Argentina.
holotype: A well-preserved incomplete skeleton without skull, with vertebrae, coracoids, a partial forelimb, pelvis and hind limbs, Portezuelo Formation, Neuquén, Argentina.
biology: Classified with the alvarezsaurids, whose short arms had a large clawed thumb; analyses group it with Bonapartenykus in Patagonykinae.
author: Novas 1994
